## Decisions (recorded at implementation)

- **Hocuspocus server + provider `4.7.0`** — the spec's named self-hosted sync server (§13.1).
  `apps/collab` composes a Hono HTTP app (`/healthz`, block-patch routes) with a Hocuspocus server
  over `ws` upgrades. `handleConnection` returns a `ClientConnection` that the upgrade handler must
  retain and feed — `ws.on("message")` → `connection.handleMessage(...)`, `ws.on("close")` →
  `connection.handleClose(...)`; calling `handleConnection` alone attaches no socket listeners (the
  first implementation timed out on this).
- **Document name `draft:<draftId>`**, shared Yjs fragment `"prosemirror"` (the `y-prosemirror`
  binding target), `?intent=ro` for read-only attaches. Frozen-fork refusal carries a
  `"frozen_fork"` code so the client rebinds to the new head — **same `Y.Doc`**, so pending offline
  edits merge into `v(N+1)` instead of being dropped.
- **Materialization is debounced in `onStoreDocument`**, not per-keystroke: the store writes
  `live_docs.y_state` + state vector, then materializes the doc through `@rhema/editor`'s canonical
  `docToMarkdown` and writes canonical markdown + `md_sha256` + revision rows. Frozen heads fork to
  `v(N+1)` `human_revision` on first stored write; run-locked/non-editable heads attach read-only and
  never materialize. Frozen version bytes are immutable — a fork never rewrites them.
- **Restore points = daily snapshot + Yjs update deltas** (§11.4): a daily snapshot blob plus
  per-trigger delta rows; reconstruction applies deltas over the snapshot and re-materializes —
  byte-identical markdown is the test. `⌘S` and page-hide send stateless `rhema.restore` messages
  through the provider; `onStateless` writes the named point and broadcasts the ack. Retention is
  per-plan (ledger F12); the sweeper expires old unnamed points while keeping named points and the
  latest snapshot.
- **`rhema_collab` limited DB role** (migration `0028_collab_restore.sql`) — the service connects as
  the limited role (never the superuser in prod); the migration also extends the
  `restore_points.cause` check for the new trigger kinds. The DB wrapper (`sql.ts`) is
  workspace-scoped on every query — cross-workspace refusal is enforced in code, which the PGlite
  harness proves even though it bypasses real RLS.
- **Session auth on the WebSocket upgrade** — the browser session cookie authenticates the
  Hocuspocus connection (`onAuthenticate` resolves the session, binds the draft's workspace to the
  session's tenant, detects frozen forks, attaches `readOnly` under run locks/non-editable heads).
  Session helpers moved to `packages/db/src/session.ts` so `apps/api` and `apps/collab` share them —
  no secrets in the bundle, no provider keys to collab.
- **`maxScale=1` on the collab Cloud Run service** — multi-instance sync needs Redis; deferred to
  the sharing-roles leg (1.x). The LB routes `/collab` + `/collab/*` to the collab service; web gets
  `COLLAB_WS_URL = wss://${app-domain}/collab` (same-origin WSS — the session cookie rides the
  upgrade). Collab's service account gets the artifacts-bucket grant (materialized versions +
  restore blobs); no provider keys.
- **Block-patch (M17)** — `@rhema/contracts` `block-patch.ts` defines the block read model
  (`{blockId, kind, markdown, hash}`), the view, the patch request (`baseHash` + `markdown`), and
  the typed error vocabulary (`hash_mismatch` → 409, `frozen_head`, `locked`, `block_not_found`).
  `apps/collab/src/blocks.ts` exposes the routes and applies the patch in a Yjs transaction tagged
  `human_mobile` — the mobile *client* is 1.x, the contract + apply path land now.
- **Sync pill vocabulary is verbatim §5.10** — `synced ✓` / `syncing…` /
  `offline · n changes queued` / `read-only` (lowercase — the spec's exact strings). No Save button,
  no unsaved-changes dialog, no `beforeunload` anywhere on the Page.

## Plan / test matrix

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Two providers converge to one doc over the collab server | `collab.test.ts` — real-socket test (two `HocuspocusProvider`s over `ws`) |
| Kill-and-reconnect resumes from local + server state | `collab.test.ts` — reconnect test over real sockets |
| Debounced materialization → canonical markdown + `md_sha256` | `collab.test.ts` materialize test |
| Frozen/run-locked docs reject mutations at the service layer | `collab.test.ts` — run-lock read-only + frozen-fork tests |
| Restore reconstructs byte-identical markdown from snapshot + deltas | `collab.test.ts` restore test |
| `⌘S` writes a named restore point | `collab.test.ts` named-restore test + `client/collab.ts` ⌘S handler |
| Per-plan retention + sweeper | `collab.test.ts` sweep test |
| Offline edits on a frozen version land in `v(N+1)` `human_revision` | `collab.test.ts` fork test + same-`Y.Doc` rebind in `client/collab.ts` |
| Frozen version bytes immutable | `collab.test.ts` — frozen artifact byte assert |
| Auth rejects missing sessions + cross-workspace | `collab.test.ts` auth test |
| Block-patch contract + typed apply path; 409 on `hash_mismatch`; refuses frozen heads | `collab.test.ts` block-patch test; `packages/contracts/src/block-patch.ts` |

## Gap table

| Gap found | Disposition |
|---|---|
| `handleConnection` alone attaches no socket listeners — providers never reached sync | Fixed — retain `ClientConnection`, forward `message`/`close` |
| Sync pill copy title-cased vs the verbatim §5.10 strings | Fixed — `copy.ts` emits the lowercase vocabulary |
| Collab SA had no artifacts-bucket grant (materialize/restore writes GCS) | Fixed — grant added in `iam.ts` |
| Invalid ULID fixtures produced opaque Hocuspocus errors | Fixed — deterministic `uid()` ids |
| Transient pnpm workspace-state corruption raced a Turbo run | Rerun clean — recorded, not a source defect |
| Restore-point dropdown/preview UI | P1.08 scope (REQ-IDE-34's UI half) |
| Multi-user collab / presence / Redis multi-instance | 1.x with sharing roles — `maxScale=1` bounds the service |
| Mobile block-patch client | 1.x (REQ-MOBILE-6) — contract + apply path landed now |
